name: skaldkeep
description: Skills for working with a Skaldkeep campaign chronicle over its MCP server: connect, use the tools, process sessions, transcribe locally, write recap songs and clean up facets.

interface.shortDescription: Campaign chronicle skills for TTRPG groups
interface.longDescription: Turn session transcripts into staged Skaldkeep campaign documents, transcribe recordings with AssemblyAI, write recap songs and keep filter values tidy. This plugin ships the skills only: the Skaldkeep MCP server must be set up separately. If the Skaldkeep tools are missing, ask Codex to "connect to Skaldkeep" (the skaldkeep-connect skill), or add it with: codex mcp add skaldkeep --url https://app.skaldkeep.gg/mcp --bearer-token-env-var SKALDKEEP_TOKEN
defaultPrompt: Process the latest session transcript in Skaldkeep.
